technique_name: Demonstrate how an animal adapts to its living environment.
description: Animals often adapt to their living environment by developing new skills to increase their chance of survival. For example, an animal may adjust its eating habits to better access available food sources, such as a bear catching fish or a bird picking up small insects with its beak. They may also alter their markings or colors to blend into their surroundings, like the chameleon’s ability to camouflage itself with its environment.
